Central Rural Sanitation Programme
†*321. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Rural Sanitation
Programme being run in Madhya Pradesh
since 1992 has been discontinued due to
instructions of running this programme
only in the districts approved for total
sanitation campaign programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Government of Madhya
Pradesh has sent projects for approval to
Central Government for 30 districts of the
State for inclusion in the said programme;
and
(d) if so, the reasons for not according
the approval and by when Central
Government are likley to accord sanction
for the same?
Expenditure incurred on the security
of VIPs
*322. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government are considering to reduce the
security provided to the hundreds of VIPs;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the total number of VIPs who have
been provided with the security; and
(d) the total expenditure incurred on the
security of VIPs annually?
Non-utilisation of funds under the
Rural Drinking Water Schemes
*323. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the outlay
for the Rural Drinking Water Schemes
is not being utilized fully for years
together;
(b) the  reasons for non-utilisation of
funds by the States for drinking water in
rural areas; and
(c) the amount earmarked for
Swajaldhara Scheme during  2002-03?

Assignment of jobs and works under
SGRY
*324. SHRI  EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Maharashtra had requested the Central
Government to assign jobs and works
under the Sampoorna Gramin Rojgar
Yojana (SGRY) to Labour Co-operative
Societies; and
(b) if so, what was the precise request
of the State Government and what decision
has been taken thereon?
Snag in the  engine of Jaguar fighter
*325. SHRI AMAR SINGH : Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Court of
Enquiry set up by Government to go into
the crash of a Jaguar fighter aircraft on May
7 near Ambala had pointed out a snag in
the engine of the aircraft which led to the
crash; and
(b) if so, the action Government have
taken in the light of the observation of the
Court of Enquiry?
Old Age Pension
†*326. SHRI ISAM SINGH: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of old persons above  the
age of 65 years in India who are living
below poverty line;
(b) whether Government are providing
old age pension to all these old people; and
(c) if not, the action Government
propose to take to ensure that pension is
provided to all these people?
Manufacturing AJTs by HAL
*327. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd.
will manufacture Advanced Jet Trainers in
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) when will they be able to meet the
full demand of Indian Air Force in this
regard?
Target for generating employment
opportunities
†*328. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set any
target to generate new opportunities of
employment in the rural areas during Tenth
Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the annual target for generating
employment opportunities; and
(c) the number of employment
opportunities that would be generated by
the end of the Tenth Plan in different
sectors, sector-wise?
Inclusion of 'Tulu' language in the
Eighth Schedule of the Constitution
*329. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal before
Government to include 'Tulu' language in
the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution;
and

Progress of fencing along Indo-Pak
border
1469. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the wire fencing of the
entire International Border between India
and Pakistan and along the line of control
on the border, has been completed; and
(b) if not what is the length fenced so
far and the length that still remains to be
fenced; and
(c) if not, when the abaove work is
likely to be completed?
Non-completion of barbed fencing
along Indo-Pak border
1470. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the barbed
wire fencing of three Indian villages-
Hethlanga, Chironda adn Silikut, spread
over merely 565 hectare area in Uri sector
on the Indo-Pak border in northern
Kashmir had been left near No Mans land
and between India and Pakistans is not
being done;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government propose to
cover the said area with barbed wire
fencing to ensure the security of the people
of above said villages; and
(d) if so, by when?
Ship reporting system
1471. SMT. JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether in a bid to have a better
coordination in search and rescur missions
on the high seas and overcome threat of
piracy, Indian Coast Guard officials  have
discussed with American and Japanese
counter-parts, the possibility of linking its
ship reporting system with that of the two
countries;
(b) if so, whether any agreement in this
regard has been reached;
(c) if so, whether US-Japanese and
Australian reporting system are already
inter-linked but the Indian system and those
operated by South Korea and China are
independent;
(d) whether Indian Government have
discussed this with the US  and Japan; and

Deveopment of A-7 rifle by ordinance
factory, Dehradun
1472. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ordinance
Factory in Dehradun developmed a A-7
rifle which is at par with AK-47 rifle;
(b) if so, the details of the discovery;
(c) whether Government propose to
give it only to CRPF  and BSF Personnel;
and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Need to increase Army's strength
1473. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Army needs its strength
to be increased commensurably; and
(b) if so, the action taken for immediate
expansion of elite forces?
Loss of pistol surrendered by General
Niazi
1474. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the pistol
surrendered by Pakistani General Niazi to
the Commander-in Chief of the Indian
Army in 1971 War, has been found missing;
(b) if so, teh details thereof  and the
persons responsible therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to recover the pistol
and the present status of the same?
Missing spares of Army Helicoptors
1475. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether any complaint regarding
missing spare parts of Army Helicopters
has been lodged with the Juswania Police
post of Badwani district of Madhya
Pradesh;
(b) whether these spare parts were being
transported to Bangalore via road; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and action
taken in this regard?
Merger of secundrabad dantonment
Board with Municipal Corporation of
Hyderband
1476. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any request from the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has been
received in the Ministry to merge
Secundrabad cantonment Board with the
Minicipal Corporation of Hyderabad;
(b) if so, when such a request was
received in the Ministry; and
(c) the action contemplated by the
Ministry in this regard?
Casualties in demining operations
1477. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of Army Personnel/
civilians killed in De-Mining operations on
the Indo-Pak Borders and LOC during the
year 2002-2003 and as on date;
(b) whether it is a fact that the casualties
during De-Mining operations were moer
mainly due to the lack of advanced De-
Mining equipments;
